note: Real, large Florida data-center proposals at their publicly reported sizes (see sources). Each test places a campus of that size at that location on a SYNTHETIC grid model; it is not a prediction about the real project or the real utility. 'status' is the catalog's bucket (for styling and sorting); 'status_reported' is the status in the sources' own words, and is what the page shows. 'mw_reported' is the size as the source words it, when that differs from the plain number tested (mw_reported_whole: it already says what the figure is, so the page does not add 'reported'). 'status_note' is the full sourced status line and 'hypothetical' means the MW is not a reported data-center load, so the test is worded as a hypothetical campus.
